usedFor: Clio holds matters, documents and contacts, and TRIGGERcmd turns a change there into “Trigger Command” on your own computers.

bestTemplate.name: “New Document” in Clio, then “Trigger Command” in TRIGGERcmd
bestTemplate.why: A new document is a clear event, and the action starts a command on your computers when it arrives.

watchOut: “Matter Updated” in Clio fires on every matter update, so one matter can run “Trigger Command” repeatedly.
